subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production dashboard Worker host this public-but-unlisted Bay experiment and own its bounded live-only status semantics?
rationale: The contributor has proved the implementation and no code defect remains, but only the dashboard owner can accept the discoverable production route and ongoing state surface.

options.title: Sponsor the experiment
options.body: Approve the public-but-unlisted route and bounded state as an explicitly experimental production surface.

options.title: Require gated access
options.body: Add Cloudflare Access or application authentication before deployment if the intended audience is maintainer-only.

options.title: Do not deploy it
options.body: Keep the prototype outside the production Worker if maintainers do not want to own the experiment.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the public-but-unlisted route and bounded state as an explicitly experimental production surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history directly connects him to the dashboard route and status-cache surface being extended.
